parsed.rationale: The ECG shows voltage criteria for LVH (deep S in V2-V3 plus tall R in V4-V5, sum well over 35 mm), and the concave ST elevation with tall T waves in V1-V3 is the usual LVH repolarization pattern, with no reciprocal changes, no convex or tombstone ST segments and no pathological Q waves, so it does not meet STEMI criteria despite your impression.
